title: Black Bean Tofu Taco Filling
description: A nostalgic, 1980s-style crunchy taco filling made with crumbled tofu, black beans, tomato paste, and classic taco spices.
instructions: Wrap the 14 ounces extra-firm tofu in a clean towel and press for 10 to 15 minutes to remove excess moisture.
Crumble the pressed tofu into small, uneven pieces about the size of cooked ground taco meat.
Heat the 1 tablespoon olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the 1 medium diced yellow onion and cook for 5 to 6 minutes, stirring often, until softened.
Add the 3 minced garlic cloves and cook for 30 seconds.
Add the crumbled tofu and cook for 8 to 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the tofu loses moisture and begins to brown in spots.
Add the 15 ounces black beans and lightly mash about half of the beans into the tofu mixture.
Stir in the 1 tablespoon chili powder, 2 teaspoons ground cumin, 1 teaspoon paprika, 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano, 3/4 teaspoon kosher salt, and 1/4 teaspoon black pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the 1 tablespoon tomato paste and 1 teaspoon low-sodium soy sauce until the tofu and beans are evenly coated.
Add the 1/2 cup low-sodium vegetable broth and simmer for 5 to 8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the filling is moist, thick, and scoopable.
Remove the skillet from the heat and stir in the 1 teaspoon apple cider vinegar.
Let the taco filling rest for 5 minutes before spooning into crunchy taco shells.
notes: For the full old-school taco night effect, serve in crunchy shells with shredded iceberg lettuce, diced tomato, reduced-fat cheddar, and mild picante-style salsa.
The tofu provides the crumbly texture, while the mashed black beans give the filling body and help it hold together.
For a drier taco filling, simmer uncovered for an extra 2 to 3 minutes.

ldlScore.reason: No cholesterol, very low saturated fat, high fiber from black beans, and plant-based protein from tofu.
